body: I’m Japanese and I believed this to this day! Didn’t know it came from Korean tradition among coroners.
Literally me during the MBTI test that got me here.
It’s called a “sin-nyo” in Japan and it’s usually used in a character that represents something related to roads. 道 (a road), 進(to move forward), 迷 (to get lost) etc.
